def physical_ancestors(raw, target):
    part = raw
    for name in target.relative_to(raw).parts:
        part = part / name
        observed = part.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(observed.st_mode) and observed.st_uid == os.geteuid(),
             "runtime IPC ancestors must be owned physical directories")
    need(target.resolve(strict=True) == target, "runtime IPC ancestors must be canonical")


def proof_job_attribution(raw, parts, *, allow_cbmc=False):
    job = re.fullmatch(r"proof\.(.+)\.[0-9]{8}t[0-9]{6}z\.[0-9a-f]{8}", parts[4])
    need(job is not None, "runtime socket WP job ID differs")
    candidate = job.group(1)
    if candidate.startswith("model.") and candidate[6:] in MEMBERS:
        function, contract = candidate[6:], "c_model." + candidate[6:]
    else:
        names = {"contract.fixture_pair_pointer_values": "swdb_pair_pointer_values",
                 "contract.fixture_pair_pointer_wrong_identity": "swdb_pair_pointer_wrong_identity"}
        need(candidate in names, "runtime socket outside the exact six WP jobs")
        function, contract = names[candidate], candidate
    physical_ancestors(raw, raw.joinpath(*parts[:5]))
    log = raw.joinpath(*parts[:5], "adapter.log")
    need(stat.S_ISREG(log.lstat().st_mode), "runtime attribution log must be regular before open")
    descriptor = os.open(log, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    try:
        log_stat = os.fstat(descriptor)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(log_stat.st_mode) and log_stat.st_uid == os.geteuid(),
             "runtime socket attribution log must be owned regular input")
        header = os.read(descriptor, 512)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    wanted = f"adapter: wp\nunit: None {function}\ncontract: {contract}\n".encode()
    if allow_cbmc and candidate in ("contract.fixture_pair_pointer_values", "contract.fixture_pair_pointer_wrong_identity"):
        cbmc = f"adapter: cbmc\nunit: library summary {contract} {function}\ncontract: {contract}\n".encode()
        if header.startswith(cbmc):
            wanted = cbmc
    need(header.startswith(wanted), "runtime entry lacks exact selected-job producer attribution")
    return function, contract, wanted


def runtime_ipc(raw, path, observed):
    """Classify metadata only. Never open, follow, connect to, or remove IPC."""
    parts = path.relative_to(raw).parts
    need(len(parts) == 8 and parts[:3] == (*PYTEST_BASE.parts, CASE_PREFIX + "0")
         and parts[3] == "runs" and parts[5:7] == ("scratch", "tmp")
         and re.fullmatch(IPC_BASENAME, parts[7]) is not None,
         "unlisted raw runtime socket path refused")
    function, contract, wanted = proof_job_attribution(raw, parts)
    need(stat.S_ISSOCK(observed.st_mode) and observed.st_size == 0
         and observed.st_uid == os.geteuid() and observed.st_dev == raw.lstat().st_dev,
         "runtime socket type/owner/device/size differs")
    physical_ancestors(raw, path.parent)
    return {"relative": str(path.relative_to(raw)), "kind": "S_IFSOCK", "bytes": 0,
            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(observed.st_mode), "uid": observed.st_uid,
            "inode": observed.st_ino, "device": observed.st_dev,
            "job": parts[4], "function": function, "contract": contract,
            "adapter_header_sha256": sha(wanted)}


def missing_owned_live_entry(raw, path):
    relative = path.relative_to(raw)
    lock = Path("mixed-pair-profile/verifier.lock")
    queue = Path("mixed-pair-profile/verifier.queue")
    if relative in (lock, lock / "owner"):
        physical_ancestors(raw, raw / "mixed-pair-profile")
        return True
    if relative.parent == queue and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{20}-[1-9][0-9]*", relative.name):
        physical_ancestors(raw, raw / queue)
        return True
    parts = relative.parts
    if (len(parts) >= 6 and parts[:3] == (*PYTEST_BASE.parts, CASE_PREFIX + "0")
            and parts[3] == "runs" and parts[5] == "scratch"):
        physical_ancestors(raw, raw.joinpath(*parts[:5]))
        proof_job_attribution(raw, parts, allow_cbmc=True)
        return True
    return False

def why3_runtime_check(expected):

    result = {}

        root = Path(name)
        need(root.resolve(strict=True) == root and root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(),
             "canonical Why3 runtime root required")
        rows, directories = [], []
        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
            observed = path.lstat()
            relative = str(path.relative_to(root))
            if stat.S_ISDIR(observed.st_mode):
                directories.append(relative)
            else:
                need(stat.S_ISREG(observed.st_mode) and path.resolve(strict=True) == path,
                     "Why3 runtime special/link input refused")
                digest = hashlib.sha256()

                        digest.update(block)

                             "sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "mode": stat.S_IMODE(observed.st_mode)})
